footer.credits: "Orbitālais templis" ir Edson Pavoni mākslas darbs, kas radīts sadarbībā ar Pedro Kaled, João Pedro Polito, Victor Baptista, João Victor Alves, André Biagioni, VK, Jonathan Querubina, Guilherme Bullejos, Eduardo Dias, Roberta Savian Rosa, Clara Marques, Daphne Alves, Flavio Vidigal, Andre Holzmeister, Pedro Vidigal, Tatiane Putti, Rafael Fernandes, Bruna Cairo, Gabriela Veiga, Kate Chapman Specter, Marcello Dantas, Anne Valls, Matias Campos Abad, Samuel Levy, Bella Nardini, Leigh Pennington, Nima Gardideh un visiem {{count}} cilvēkiem, kuri jau ir nosūtījuši vārdus šim templim.
